awaiting: Phase-1: Van Krevelen 1990 Ch. 10 physics baseline for RI (molar refraction group contribution)
Phase-1: extend to Abbe number (RI dispersion) prediction for optical coating design
Phase-1: apply mixed-source methodology to density (both datasets have density)
capability: Mixed OpenPoly + RadonPy refractive index ML with split-conformal PI. n_combined = 1223 polymers (148 literature + 1075 MD-simulated), source-stratified 60/20/20 split. RandomForest base + Papadopoulos et al 2002 split-conformal. REAL POSITIVE FINDING: overall test MAE = 0.0304 RI units, R² = +0.6381, Pearson r = +0.8047. 95% PI coverage = 0.9634, PI width = 0.2264 RI units. RadonPy R² = +0.7901, OpenPoly coverage = 0.8387. Adds optical/transparency coating IP capability to portfolio. Same methodology as Push #34 dielectric. Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority.

contrast_with_push_34_dielectric_mixed_b.note: Same methodology as Push #34 applied to different property. Direct portfolio-integration evidence.

metrics.name: overall_test_mae_below_0_05
metrics.note: Overall test MAE = 0.0304 < 0.05 RI units. Sub-3% relative error given the ~1.2-2.4 RI range. Refractive index is TIGHTER bounded than dielectric constant (Push #34), so MAE is much smaller in absolute terms.

metrics.name: overall_test_r2_at_least_0_5
metrics.note: Overall test R² = +0.6381 ≥ 0.5. Pearson r = +0.8047. Strong predictive capability on both openpoly literature and RadonPy MD data.

metrics.name: overall_pi_coverage_within_5pct_of_target
metrics.note: Overall 95% PI coverage = 0.9634, deviation +0.0134. PI width = 0.2264 RI units. Conformal guarantee validated on mixed refractive index sources.

metrics.name: radonpy_r2_at_least_0_5
metrics.note: RadonPy test R² = +0.7901, MAE = 0.0253, Pearson r = +0.8890, coverage = 0.9814.

metrics.name: openpoly_slice_documented_in_domain
metrics.note: OpenPoly test MAE = 0.0662, R² = -0.2528, coverage = 0.8387. Modest R² reflects the very narrow openpoly RI range (which yields low denominator variance). Coverage is decent even without positive R².

metrics.name: portfolio_integration_with_push_34_documented
metrics.note: Same mixed-source methodology as Push #34 dielectric (KPI SHA-256 da54f0e073f40499a24ac76a96053f144dbde1425c0ebb32258fe047c92086c4) applied to a NEW coating property. Refractive index adds optical/transparency coating capability.

population: Combined n = 1223 polymers with refractive index. OpenPoly range [1.255, 2.387075], RadonPy range [1.274131972, 1.838878626]. Source-stratified 60/20/20: train 733, calib 244, test 246.
theory: RadonPy PI1070 (Fujimoto et al. 2023 J. Chem. Theory Comput.)
